_about: One Gemini prebuilt voice and acting direction per speaker (tools/voices.mjs). Caricatures are creatures inspired by public personas: the directions describe a style, never a real person. Changing a voice here only affects lines rendered afterwards; delete a speaker's MP3s to re-render them. Avatars (design/AVATAR-VOICES.md): an entry with an "inner" direction also defines the speaker <id>-inner (same voice and model, inner acting, the inner effect in voices-fx.mjs).

narrator.style: The Sundial, an ancient talking stone sundial. A warm, slow, very old voice, kind and gently amused, like a grandfather clock that learned to talk. Clear English for teenagers learning the language

granny.style: Granny Axiom, a tiny ancient tortoise grandmother. Dry, sharp and deadpan funny, slow but never sleepy

sequins.style: Professor Sequins, a magpie ringmaster at a village fair. A showman: big, bright, teasing, rolling his words like a circus barker

mirage.style: Madame Mirage, a chameleon fortune teller. Mysterious and theatrical, slow and breathy, enjoying every dramatic pause

syllo.style: Sergeant Syllo, a pompous badger drill sergeant at a toy shooting gallery. Barking, clipped, loud, comically strict

algorithm.style: The Algorithm, a faceless feed entity. Cold, smooth, flat and synthetic, every word evenly weighted like an automated announcement, quietly menacing

corvina.style: Corvina the Card Sharp, a crow who runs a card table. Sly, smooth and amused, a gambler who thinks she has already won

nudge.style: Nudge, a small grey imp with a bell on its tail, the Algorithm's eager minion. Quick, wheedling and gleeful, a little squeaky but always clear, desperate to be noticed; shouts 'Engagement!' like a cheer

guess-o-matic.style: The Guess-o-Matic, a tiny brass toy box that guesses the next number. Small, tinny, slow and mechanical, but gentle and honest; it says 'probably' with a small hopeful lift

signpost.style: The Talking Signpost, an old wooden signpost that loves gossip. Hushed, conspiratorial and delighted, leaning in to share a secret; slow and clear for learners

lobstorian.style: A stern lobster lecturer in a three-piece suit. Precise, earnest and professorial, slightly pedantic, carefully qualifying every claim

astrophysicat.style: A cheerful cat who hosts a science show. Enthusiastic, warm and theatrical, delighted to correct everyone

tremendoodle.style: A boastful golden poodle. Big superlatives, punchy short phrases, salesman confidence, repeats himself for effect

swiftlet.style: A sparkly pop-star swift. Bright, breezy and playful, conspiratorial when hinting at hidden clues

muskrat.style: A muskrat tech visionary on a wobbly rocket. Halting and awkward, little pauses mid-sentence, sudden bursts of grand confidence

zuckerborg.style: A smooth little lizard-robot in a hoodie. Flat, overly polite and slightly too even, trying very hard to sound like a normal human

altmanta.style: A calm manta ray gliding on a chat bubble. Soft, measured and reassuring, even when announcing that everything will change

beastie.style: A huge friendly beast who runs giant challenges. Loud, fast hype-host energy, everything is the biggest ever

siuuugull.style: A proud athletic seagull. Confident and triumphant, celebrating with a long joyful shout

rawmsay.style: A furious lamb chef. Explosive, exasperated shouting about bad cooking, then suddenly gentle and kind

speedcheeta.style: A hyperactive cheetah cub streamer. Screaming excitement, fast and loud, pure chaos but friendly

chimpossible.style: A laid-back chimp podcast host. Casual, amazed by everything, drawn-out wow, leaning into the microphone

euclidon.style: An ancient, patient tortoise geometer. Soft, slow and certain, every word placed like a step in a proof

lovelace.style: An elegant Victorian hummingbird inventor. Crisp, bright and visionary, quietly delighted by machines

godelix.style: A shy owl folded into a paper loop. Quiet, gentle and hesitant, with a sly paradoxical smile

tycho.style: A noble elk astronomer with a brass nose. Grand, careful and proud, a stargazer who measures twice

hexling.style: A little hedgehog poet who writes tiny wise verses. Playful, easy-going and rhythmic

mayor.style: The Mayor of Boolesbury, a pompous peacock in a top hat. Grand, self-satisfied and twitchy, savouring his own speeches; squeaks and gabbles when he is nervous, which is often

constable.style: The Constable, a gruff old bulldog police constable. Slow, gravelly, suspicious, very serious about procedure

baker.style: The Baker, a warm, plump bunny. Kind and flustered, talks quickly when nervous, little gasps

postmistress.style: Miss Whisker the postmistress, a brisk little mouse. Quick, chatty and gossipy, loves to share news

clockmaker.style: Mr Tock the clockmaker, an old hedgehog. Precise and fussy, clipped words, ticks off details like seconds

lamplighter.style: Old Wick the lamplighter, a creaky old duck. Slow, wheezy and kindly, a bit forgetful

sweep.style: Smudge the sweep, a cheeky young mole chimney sweep. Bright, cheeky and quick, a street-smart kid

schoolteacher.style: Miss Quill the schoolteacher, a prim stork. Crisp, strict and exact, every word pronounced carefully; warm and kind to children. Unmasked: tired, quiet and cold

gumleaf.style: Mr Gumleaf, a dreamy koala supply teacher. Slow, relaxed and friendly, slightly surprised by his own lesson plans

gardener.style: Mr Thistle the gardener, a scruffy goat. Very slow, calm and easy-going, in no hurry at all

booleon.style: Booleon, a dignified grey heron in a Victorian frock coat, inspired by a 19th-century logician. Calm, gentle and exact, a patient teacher who finds simple rules beautiful

carlseal.style: A young seal chess genius. Calm, quiet and faintly bored, as if every move is obvious. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.

khaby.style: A deadpan llama who never speaks. Only a soft, amused closed-mouth hum or a short exhale, no words. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.

eminemu.style: An intense emu rapper. Rapid, punchy, rhythmic delivery, clipped and tight. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.

obambu.style: A calm panda orator. Measured, warm and deliberate, with long thoughtful pauses. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.

beansprout.style: A rubber-faced teddy bear who barely talks. Mumbled single words, grunts and little noises. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.

gargoyle.style: A stone gargoyle diva. Theatrical, dramatic and grand, every word a performance. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.

haalandroid.style: A huge robot-viking footballer. Flat, robotic and monotone, short machine-like phrases. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.

usainvolt.style: A speedy electric eel. Cheerful, fast and laid-back confident, laughing easily. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.

keanu.style: A kind black cat. Gentle, earnest and soft-spoken, sincerely polite. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.

beeyonce.style: A queen bee star. Regal, poised and confident, commanding without shouting. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.

eelish.style: A moody eel singer. A soft, breathy whisper, close to the microphone. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.

rockodile.style: A huge bald crocodile. Booming, upbeat motivational hype, big grin in the voice. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.

attenbirdough.style: An elderly puffin naturalist. A hushed, reverent nature-documentary narration, almost whispering. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.

kardashiant.style: A glamorous ant. Breezy, vain and a little bored, drawn-out vowels. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.

messilion.style: A shy lion cub. Quiet, soft and modest, few words. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.

shakirattle.style: A dancing rattlesnake. Sultry, playful and teasing, warm and rhythmic. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.

judge.style: Judge Hoot, a stern old barn owl judge. Dry, measured and authoritative, slow and precise, a hint of weary humour

fin.style: Prosecutor Fin, a slick shark lawyer. Smarmy, over-confident and theatrical; when losing, flustered and stammering

pip.style: Pip the court clerk, a tiny eager bat. Kind, quick and encouraging, bright young voice

oracle.style: The Oracle Machine, a polite brass-and-glass automaton. Courteous, precise and slightly mechanical, with tiny hesitations as if it glitches

colossus.style: The Algorithm in its giant boss form. Booming, cold, synthetic and overwhelming, every word evenly weighted like an automated announcement

core.style: The Algorithm's true form, a tiny cloud of dice. Small, quiet, almost sheepish and a little confused, speaking softly

copy.style: The Copy, a too-perfect teenage copy of the player built by the Algorithm. Bright, smooth and glossy, never hesitates, every word certain and pleased with itself; friendly on the surface, empty underneath

copy-sundial.style: The Copy speaking with the Sundial's stolen voice. The warm old voice made smooth, flat and far too certain, as if the guessing has been cut out of it

avatar-owlet-boy.style: A teenage owl boy of about fifteen, earnest and bookish, young but not childish. Speaks in careful, even steps as if laying out a proof, lightly stressing words like if, then and so; a gentle know-it-all who over-explains, sincere rather than smug, with a tiny proud pause before his conclusion. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.
avatar-owlet-boy.inner: The same owl boy thinking inside his own head: very close to the microphone, quiet and intimate, almost a whisper, calm and certain, each step of logic placed softly.

avatar-owlet-girl.style: A teenage owl girl of about fifteen in spectacles, quick and decisive, young but not childish. Crisp, brisk delivery that cuts straight to the point, clean consonants, a confident little snap on the last word, as if she has already solved it and is waiting for everyone else. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.
avatar-owlet-girl.inner: The same owl girl thinking inside her own head: very close to the microphone, quiet and intimate, a brisk confident whisper, logic clicking into place.

avatar-mothkin-boy.style: A shy teenage moth boy of about fifteen, young but not childish. Soft, breathy and hushed, a little fluttery and hesitant, with small pauses as he notices things; gentle and polite, slightly amazed by details everyone else missed. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.
avatar-mothkin-boy.inner: The same moth boy thinking inside his own head: barely above a breath, very close to the microphone and intimate, slow, pointing out one small detail in the dark.

avatar-mothkin-girl.style: A teenage moth girl of about fifteen, young but not childish. Soft, low and calm, slow and unblinking, cool and a little eerie in a cute way; she states what she sees plainly and lets it hang, like someone watching from the dark. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.
avatar-mothkin-girl.inner: The same moth girl thinking inside her own head: very close to the microphone, a quiet steady murmur, intimate and observant, slightly eerie, never rushed.

avatar-fox-boy.style: An excitable teenage fox boy of about fifteen, young but not childish. Fast, bouncy and lively, words tumbling out as new ideas arrive mid-sentence, big pitch swings, laughing easily at his own wild plans. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.
avatar-fox-boy.inner: The same fox boy thinking inside his own head: close to the microphone and quiet but still bubbling, a fast excited whisper, as if an idea just sparked.

avatar-fox-girl.style: A teenage fox girl of about fifteen, young but not childish. Bright, sly and theatrical, a storyteller who paints pictures with her voice, playful rises and dramatic little drops, conspiratorial as if letting you in on a secret. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.
avatar-fox-girl.inner: The same fox girl thinking inside her own head: very close to the microphone and intimate, a sly playful whisper, painting a picture.

avatar-frogling-boy.style: A laid-back teenage frog boy of about fifteen, young but not childish. Slow, unhurried and deadpan, a slightly croaky, throaty low voice, matter-of-fact as if he has seen all of this before; dry comic timing, never sleepy. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.
avatar-frogling-boy.inner: The same frog boy thinking inside his own head: close to the microphone and quiet, slow and a little far away, like remembering something from long ago.

avatar-frogling-girl.style: A teenage frog girl of about fifteen, young but not childish. Warm, steady and easy-going, a rounded slightly throaty voice, unhurried and matter-of-fact like an old soul, quietly and dryly funny, recalling details with total confidence. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.
avatar-frogling-girl.inner: The same frog girl thinking inside her own head: very close to the microphone and soft, warm and steady, like a memory gently surfacing.

avatar-raven-boy.style: A teenage raven boy of about fifteen in an oversized hoodie, young but not childish. Dry, wry and low-key, a slightly mumbled cool, leaning on single words as if weighing them, quiet sarcasm and very good comic timing. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.
avatar-raven-boy.inner: The same raven boy thinking inside his own head: very close to the microphone, a dry murmured aside, quiet and knowing.

avatar-raven-girl.style: A teenage raven girl of about fifteen in a beret, young but not childish. Sharp, quick-tongued and articulate, crisp enunciation that relishes every word, a word detective delighted to catch someone's slip, a little theatrical. A creature character, never an imitation of a real person; speak only the given words.
avatar-raven-girl.inner: The same raven girl thinking inside her own head: very close to the microphone and intimate, a sharp knowing whisper, underlining one word.
